result.markdown: --- title: "Rerunning DSS with C/T SNPs masked" author: "Kathleen Durkin" date: "2026-11-04" categories: ["ceasmallr"] format: html: toc: true code-fold: true execute: eval: TRUE engine: knitr bibliography: ../../../references.bib --- An important step of methylation analysis is excluding positions at which some individuals have C-\>T SNP variants, as this can lead to false-positive unmethylated cytosine calls. I'd already called SNPs from the offspring data using `BS-Snper` at `ceasmallr/code/12-snp-calling-BS-Snper`. I've now replicated the same code for use on the parent data at `ceasmallr/code/12.1-snp-calling-BS-Snper-parents`. For both `.Rmd` files, I've also added code to save a file of just C-T SNPs, for use with masking. I then duplicated the scripts used to run `DSS` methylation analysis on both the offspring and parent data, adding a filtration step to remove C/T SNPs from the input `.cov.gz` files before loading as a BSseq object. Full code can be found at: [10.01-diff-methyl-DSS-CTmask](github.com/shedurkin/ceasmallr/blob/main/code/10.01-diff-methyl-DSS-CTmask.md) [10.11-diff-methyl-DSS-parents-CTmask](github.com/shedurkin/ceasmallr/blob/main/code/10.11-diff-methyl-DSS-parents-CTmask.md) AI Disclosures:\ -- Analysis (BS-Snper and DSS work detailed here, linked above)\ -- Below summary visualizations ## Results Comparing DSS outputs using unmasked and CT-SNP-masked datasets ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Load packages library(dplyr) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Attaching package: 'dplyr' ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` The following objects are masked from 'package:stats': filter, lag ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` The following objects are masked from 'package:base': intersect, setdiff, setequal, union ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} library(readr) library(stringr) library(tidyr) library(purrr) library(ggplot2) # Run from ceasmallr/code/ code_dir <- "../../../../ceasmallr/code" out_dir <- "../../../../ceasmallr/output" runs <- tribble( ~dataset, ~masking, ~md, ~out, "Offspring", "Unmasked", "10-diff-methyl-DSS_remsamples.md", "10-diff-methyl-DSS_remsamples", "Offspring", "CT-masked", "10.01-diff-methyl-DSS-CTmask.md", "10.01-diff-methyl-DSS-CTmask", "Parents", "Unmasked", "10.1-diff-methyl-DSS-parents.md", "10.1-diff-methyl-DSS-parents", "Parents", "CT-masked", "10.11-diff-methyl-DSS-parents-CTmask.md", "10.11-diff-methyl-DSS-parents-CTmask" ) %>% mutate(masking = factor(masking, levels = c("Unmasked", "CT-masked"))) mask_cols <- c("Unmasked" = "grey60", "CT-masked" = "#2C7FB8") # ---- helpers ---------------------------------------------------------------- # Pull the first number from a knitted-output line ("## ...") matching `pattern` md_num <- function(md_file, pattern) { lines <- read_lines(file.path(code_dir, md_file)) hit <- str_match(lines, paste0("^\\s*##\\s+", pattern))[, 2] hit <- hit[!is.na(hit)] if (length(hit) == 0) return(NA_real_) as.numeric(hit[1]) } # Count rows in a BED (empty file -> 0) bed_n <- function(path) { if (!file.exists(path) || file.size(path) == 0) return(0L) length(read_lines(path)) } read_dml <- function(path, diff_name) { read_tsv(path, col_names = c("chr", "start", "end", diff_name), col_types = "ciid") } # ---- 1. Run-level summary values -------------------------------------------- run_summary <- runs %>% mutate( loci_bsseq = map_dbl(md, md_num, "(\\d+) methylation loci"), loci_retained = map_dbl(md, md_num, "Loci retained after coverage filter: (\\d+)"), mf_trt_DML = map_dbl(md, md_num, "Treatment DMLs \\(FDR < 0\\.05\\): (\\d+)"), mf_intx_DML = map_dbl(md, md_num, "Loci with (?:stage|sex)-dependent treatment effect \\(FDR < 0\\.05\\): (\\d+)"), mf_trt_DMR = map_dbl(out, ~ bed_n(file.path(out_dir, .x, "treatment_DMR.bed"))) ) # ---- Plot 1: loci in BSseq object / retained after filter ------------------- p_loci <- run_summary %>% select(dataset, masking, loci_bsseq, loci_retained) %>% pivot_longer(c(loci_bsseq, loci_retained), names_to = "stage", values_to = "n") %>% mutate(stage = recode(stage, loci_bsseq = "In BSseq object", loci_retained = "After coverage filter"), stage = factor(stage, levels = c("In BSseq object", "After coverage filter"))) %>% ggplot(aes(stage, n / 1e6, fill = masking)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2fM", n / 1e6)), position = position_dodge(0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) + facet_wrap(~ dataset) + scale_fill_manual(values = mask_cols) + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) + labs(x = NULL, y = "CpG loci (millions)", fill = NULL, title = "Loci entering DSS, with vs. without C/T SNP masking") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") p_loci ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](2026_11_04_CTmask_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-1-1.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # ---- Plot 2: multifactor results -------------------------------------------- p_mf <- run_summary %>% select(dataset, masking, mf_trt_DML, mf_intx_DML, mf_trt_DMR) %>% pivot_longer(starts_with("mf_"), names_to = "result", values_to = "n") %>% mutate(result = recode(result, mf_trt_DML = "Treatment DMLs\n(FDR < 0.05)", mf_intx_DML = "Interaction DMLs\n(stage/sex-dependent)", mf_trt_DMR = "Treatment DMRs")) %>% ggplot(aes(result, n, fill = masking)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) + geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(n)), position = position_dodge(0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) + facet_wrap(~ dataset, scales = "free_y") + scale_fill_manual(values = mask_cols) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Count", fill = NULL, title = "Multifactor DSS model (~ treatment + stage/sex [+ interaction])") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") p_mf ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](2026_11_04_CTmask_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-1-2.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # ---- Plot 3: within-stage / within-sex smoothed tests ----------------------- group_files <- tribble( ~dataset, ~group, ~prefix, "Offspring", "Zygote", "zygote", "Offspring", "Larvae", "larvae", "Parents", "Egg", "female", "Parents", "Sperm", "male" ) group_counts <- runs %>% select(dataset, masking, out) %>% inner_join(group_files, by = "dataset", relationship = "many-to-many") %>% mutate(DMLs = map2_int(out, prefix, ~ bed_n(file.path(out_dir, .x, paste0(.y, "_DML.bed")))), DMRs = map2_int(out, prefix, ~ bed_n(file.path(out_dir, .x, paste0(.y, "_DMR.bed"))))) %>% select(dataset, masking, group, DMLs, DMRs) p_group <- group_counts %>% pivot_longer(c(DMLs, DMRs), names_to = "type", values_to = "n") %>% mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Zygote", "Larvae", "Egg", "Sperm"))) %>% ggplot(aes(group, n, fill = masking)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) + geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(n)), position = position_dodge(0.8), vjust = -0.3, size = 2.8) + facet_wrap(~ type, scales = "free_y") + scale_fill_manual(values = mask_cols) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Count", fill = NULL, title = "Within-stage / within-sex smoothed DMLtest (exposed vs. control)") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") p_group ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](2026_11_04_CTmask_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-1-3.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # ---- Plot 4: parent-offspring (and within-generation) DML overlaps ---------- # Recomputed from the DML BEDs so both versions use matching inputs: # Unmasked = 10-diff-methyl-DSS_remsamples offspring x 10.1 parents # CT-masked = 10.01 offspring x 10.11 parents load_dmls <- function(off_out, par_out) { list( zyg = read_dml(file.path(out_dir, off_out, "zygote_DML.bed"), "zyg_diff"), lar = read_dml(file.path(out_dir, off_out, "larvae_DML.bed"), "lar_diff"), egg = read_dml(file.path(out_dir, par_out, "female_DML.bed"), "egg_diff"), sperm = read_dml(file.path(out_dir, par_out, "male_DML.bed"), "sperm_diff") ) } by_loc <- c("chr", "start", "end") # every 2- and 3-way combination of DML sets; concordant = all diffs share one sign overlap_stats <- function(d) { combs <- unlist(lapply(2:3, function(k) combn(names(d), k, simplify = FALSE)), recursive = FALSE) map_dfr(combs, function(cmb) { j <- reduce(d[cmb], inner_join, by = by_loc) s <- sign(as.matrix(j[, paste0(cmb, "_diff"), drop = FALSE])) tibble(comparison = paste(cmb, collapse = " x "), n_sets = length(cmb), n_shared = nrow(j), n_concordant = sum(apply(s, 1, function(r) length(unique(r)) == 1))) }) } overlaps <- bind_rows( overlap_stats(load_dmls("10-diff-methyl-DSS_remsamples", "10.1-diff-methyl-DSS-parents")) %>% mutate(masking = "Unmasked"), overlap_stats(load_dmls("10.01-diff-methyl-DSS-CTmask", "10.11-diff-methyl-DSS-parents-CTmask")) %>% mutate(masking = "CT-masked") ) %>% mutate(masking = factor(masking, levels = c("Unmasked", "CT-masked")), pct_concordant = 100 * n_concordant / n_shared, type = case_when(comparison %in% c("zyg x lar", "egg x sperm") ~ "Within generation", n_sets == 2 ~ "Parent x offspring", TRUE ~ "Three-way"), comparison = str_replace_all(comparison, c("zyg" = "Zygote", "lar" = "Larvae", "egg" = "Egg", "sperm" = "Sperm"))) p_overlap <- overlaps %>% mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("Parent x offspring", "Three-way", "Within generation"))) %>% ggplot(aes(reorder(comparison, n_shared), n_shared, fill = masking)) + geom_col(position = position_dodge(0.8), width = 0.75) + geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%s (%.0f%%)", scales::comma(n_shared), pct_concordant)), position = position_dodge(0.8), hjust = -0.1, size = 2.6) + coord_flip() + facet_grid(type ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") + scale_fill_manual(values = mask_cols) + scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) + labs(x = NULL, y = "Shared DMLs (exact CpG position)", fill = NULL, title = "DML overlaps, with vs. without C/T SNP masking", subtitle = "Label: n shared (% direction-concordant across all sets)") + theme_bw() + theme(legend.position = "bottom") p_overlap ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](2026_11_04_CTmask_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-1-4.png){width=672} ::: ```{.r .cell-code} # ---- Combined table of percent change --------------------------------------- pct_change <- bind_rows( run_summary %>% select(dataset, masking, loci_bsseq, loci_retained, mf_trt_DML, mf_intx_DML, mf_trt_DMR) %>% pivot_longer(-c(dataset, masking), names_to = "metric", values_to = "n"), group_counts %>% pivot_longer(c(DMLs, DMRs), names_to = "type", values_to = "n") %>% transmute(dataset, masking, metric = paste(group, type), n), overlaps %>% transmute(dataset = "Overlap", masking, metric = comparison, n = n_shared) ) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = masking, values_from = n) %>% mutate(pct_change = 100 * (`CT-masked` - Unmasked) / Unmasked) knitr::kable(pct_change, digits = 1, format.args = list(big.mark = ",")) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} |dataset |metric | Unmasked| CT-masked| pct_change| x Larvae x Egg | 47| 41| -12.8| |Overlap |Zygote x Larvae x Sperm | 114| 101| -11.4| |Overlap |Zygote x Egg x Sperm | 18| 21| 16.7| |Overlap |Larvae x Egg x Sperm | 30| 29| -3.3| ::: ::: \ Looking through the results, there seems to be minimal qualitative difference in results -- C/T SNP masking just slightly reduced the number of input loci and number of identified DMLs and DMRs, which is to be expected. More interesting is an instance where the CT-SNP-masked input led to an increaed \# of identified features: From the parent data, within-sex tests found *more* DMLs and DMRs in the egg samples after masking This isn't too weird though. Masking C/T SNPs is expected to remove a portion of identified DMLs (e.g., SNP artifacts). However, one would also expect some "gains", from loci whose signal was being hidden by nearby SNPs.
